# bintables/div

> / : signed division with `idiv` (quotient in rax).

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/div.pkg) · translates [std/div](../std/div.md)

`cqo` sign-extends `rax` into `rdx:rax` before `idiv`. Division by zero
raises a CPU exception, which kills the program (SIGFPE).

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when right simple`

```nasm
{left}
mov rbx, {right.operand}
cqo
idiv rbx
```

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
cqo
idiv rbx
```

Includes: [bintables/binop](binop.md)
